@@U00913@@
It isn’t just science is needed, but infinite patience. A quiet spirit nurses it year after year for ages, for time alone makes the subtle ferment potent. And then there’s all the marvelous things go in it. True, the Devil taught her to make it, and yet the Devil can’t make it himself.

@@U00914@@
(He sees the MONKEYS.)

@@U00915@@
Now there’s a petite crew! That one’s the maid, and that the houseboy.

@@U00916@@
(To the MONKEYS.)

@@U00917@@
It seems your mistress is away.

@@U00919@@
Out, Roundabout, Up the chimney spout!

@@U00921@@
How long does she go gadding about?

@@U00923@@
Long as it takes to warm our Paws.

@@U00925@@
(To 浮士德.)

@@U00926@@
What do you think of our dainty menagerie?

@@U00928@@
I've never seen anything so gross.

@@U00930@@
But little chats like this are great fun.
translation:
@@U00913@@
这不仅需要科学，还需要无限的耐心。一种安静的精神年复一年地滋养着它，因为只有时间才能使微妙的发酵变得强大。然后里面就有了所有奇妙的事情。确实，魔鬼教她做到这一点，但魔鬼自己却做不到。

@@U00914@@
（他看到了猴子。）

@@U00915@@
现在有一个小团队！那个是女仆，那个是男仆。

@@U00916@@
（对猴子们来说。）

@@U00917@@
看来你的女主人不在了。

@@U00919@@
出去，回旋处，爬上烟囱喷口！

@@U00921@@
她要闲逛多久？

@@U00923@@
需要很长时间才能温暖我们的爪子。

@@U00925@@
（致浮士德。）

@@U00926@@
你觉得我们可爱的动物园怎么样？

@@U00928@@
我从来没有见过如此恶心的事情。

@@U00930@@
但像这样的小聊天很有趣。
